title: VoidUtils
description: Essential patches and anti-exploit tools for Beta 1.7.3 anarchy servers
body:
# 🛠️ VoidUtils

VoidUtils is a lightweight utility plugin designed for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 servers running Bukkit 1060. It includes essential patches for common exploits, dupe bugs, and performance threats — ideal for anarchy or vanilla servers.

# ✅ Features


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

    🛑 Anti Coord Logger
    Prevents hacked clients from logging coordinates when disconnecting.

    🚫 Bedrock & Illegal Placement Protection
    Blocks bedrock, portal blocks, and other illegal items from being placed.

    💣 Piston Dupe Patch
    Prevents duplication glitches involving pistons and chests.

    🛶 Boat Placement Only on Water
    Stops land boat placement used for chunk crashes.

    🎒 Negative Stack Patch
    Blocks items with invalid stack sizes (e.g. -1 dirt).

    📦 Freecam Dupe Patch
    Detects and blocks Freecam-based chest duplication.

    💀 /kill Command
    Adds /kill command for players to respawn voluntarily.

    🕳️ Void Fall Teleport
    If a player falls below Y=-64, teleports them to safe ground above.

    🧩 Optional xAuth integration
    Supports xAuth session tracking for AntiCoordLogger.

</details>

# ⚙️ Configuration

A config.yml is generated on first run with toggle options for each patch.

# 🧱 Compatibility

    Minecraft: Beta 1.7.3

    Server: Bukkit 1060

    Not compatible with modern versions.

# 📁 Installation

    Drop VoidUtils.jar into your server’s plugins/ folder.

    Start your server.

    Edit plugins/VoidUtils/config.yml if needed.
